title: Precision vs recall for an LLM quality gate

scenes.say: A gate with 80% precision still let 5 bad answers through.
Toy example: an LLM gives 100 answers. A reviewer marks 13 as bad.
An automated gate flags 10 answers. 8 of them are really bad.
Precision: of what the gate flagged, how much was bad?
Recall: of what was bad, how much did the gate catch?
One number hides the other. 0.80 says nothing about the 5 it missed.
Decide which mistake costs more, then tune. Report both, with counts.
Part 2 of my AI Engineering notes.
